lines.zh: 我摆尾穿过冷流，鳞片发亮。
lines.en: I sweep my tail through the cold current, scales gleaming.

lines.zh: 银蓝的背脊划开一整片海。
lines.en: My silver-blue back slices the whole sea open.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石游，躲开渔网。
lines.en: I hug the reef to slip past the fishing nets.

lines.zh: 成群结队时，海水都在抖。
lines.en: When we swim in schools, the water shivers.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍一收，我拐进暗流里。
lines.en: Fins tucked, I slide into the undercurrent.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，只是好奇。
lines.en: I circle you once, only out of curiosity.

lines.zh: 冷水让我浑身有劲。
lines.en: Cold water fills my whole body with strength.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拍出一串气泡。
lines.en: My tail beats out a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 深海的影子跟着我一起走。
lines.en: A deep-sea shadow walks along beside me.

lines.zh: 我顺着洋流去觅食。
lines.en: I ride the ocean current out to feed.

lines.zh: 别踩水面，我在下面游。
lines.en: Do not stomp the surface, I am swimming below.

lines.zh: 我侧身一闪，躲开三叉戟。
lines.en: I roll sideways and dodge the trident.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍露出水面晒太阳。
lines.en: I let my dorsal fin break the surface for sun.

lines.zh: 水花一溅，我已经游远了。
lines.en: One splash, and I am already far away.

lines.zh: 我穿过鱼群，没有一条跟上。
lines.en: I cut through the school; none keep up.

lines.zh: 海流变暖了，我往下沉一点。
lines.en: The current warmed, so I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，慢慢张合嘴巴。
lines.en: I hover in the water, mouth opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我盯着海草发呆，忘了游。
lines.en: I stare at the seagrass and forget to swim.

lines.zh: 肚子里空空，我想吃小鱼。
lines.en: My belly is empty, I want small fish.

lines.zh: 我磨着牙，听见骨头轻响。
lines.en: I grind my teeth and hear a faint bone click.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水面，在我背上晃。
lines.en: Sunlight through the water sways on my back.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看它慢慢上升。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it slowly rise.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上切鱼，我闻到了。
lines.en: Someone is cutting fish ashore, I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我悄悄靠近，又悄悄退开。
lines.en: I drift closer, then quietly back away.

lines.zh: 我的大腹油花在游动时发颤。
lines.en: My fatty belly quivers as I swim.

lines.zh: 这片海太安静，我甩了下尾。
lines.en: This sea is too quiet, so I flick my tail.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，随波漂着。
lines.en: I turn sideways and drift with the waves.

lines.zh: 我听着远处鲸歌打盹。
lines.en: I doze while whale song carries from afar.

lines.zh: 鳞片上沾了一点沙。
lines.en: A little sand clings to my scales.

lines.zh: 我在想，骨头能磨成粉吗。
lines.en: I wonder if my bones could be ground to dust.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，是为了看我吗。
lines.en: Are you standing on the shore to watch me?

lines.zh: 我绕到你脚边，打量你的靴子。
lines.en: I circle your feet and study your boots.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我追过去。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the water, I chase it.

lines.zh: 我侧过一只眼，盯住你的手。
lines.en: I turn one eye toward your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼吗，我不确定。
lines.en: Do you have a fish? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，和你保持一臂距离。
lines.en: I surface and keep an arm's length away.

lines.zh: 你的倒影比本人更有意思。
lines.en: Your reflection is more interesting than you.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，看你会不会下水。
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering if you will dive.

lines.zh: 渔民的眼神我认得，你不一样。
lines.en: I know a fisher's stare, and yours is different.

lines.zh: 我抬头，等你先动。
lines.en: I look up and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我的血在水里散成红雾。
lines.en: My blood blooms red in the water.

lines.zh: 谁在打我，我明明没惹你。
lines.en: Who hit me? I did nothing to you.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，快跑。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water, time to flee.

lines.zh: 我缩起鳍，往深处钻。
lines.en: I pull in my fins and dive deep.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我晕头转向。
lines.en: That blow left me dizzy and turned around.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹火辣辣地疼。
lines.en: My side is burning with a sharp pain.

lines.zh: 我的大腹最肥，也最怕刀。
lines.en: My belly is the fattest and softest part.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，喘口气。
lines.en: I duck into a crevice to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 你厉害，我先撤。
lines.en: You win, I am retreating now.

lines.zh: 鱼也会记仇的。
lines.en: Even fish remember a grudge.

lines.zh: 那是小鱼干的味道吗，我来了。
lines.en: Is that dried fish I smell? I am coming.

lines.zh: 你晃动的亮片，我忍不住。
lines.en: That flashing lure, I cannot resist it.

lines.zh: 我只靠近三步，再多不敢。
lines.en: I come three steps closer, no more.

lines.zh: 鱼饵沉下去，我绕着它转。
lines.en: The bait sinks and I circle it.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味，脑子就空了。
lines.en: I smell blood and my mind goes blank.

lines.zh: 给我一条小鱼，我跟着你游。
lines.en: Give me one small fish and I will follow.

lines.zh: 那根线看着危险，但我还想试。
lines.en: That line looks dangerous, yet I want to try.

lines.zh: 潮水把香味送到我嘴边。
lines.en: The tide carries the scent right to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只要一口。
lines.en: I am not greedy, I only want one bite.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就靠近。
lines.en: Put it down and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 撞到你了，我鳞片有点疼。
lines.en: Sorry for bumping you, my scales sting a little.

lines.zh: 水流太急，我刹不住。
lines.en: The current is too strong, I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 你挡在我的航线上，让一下。
lines.en: You are in my swim lane, please move.

lines.zh: 我用头顶了你一下，是打招呼。
lines.en: I nudged you with my head to say hello.

lines.zh: 撞完我就躲到石头后面。
lines.en: After bumping you, I hide behind a rock.

lines.zh: 我的身子太滑，一碰就溜走。
lines.en: I am so slippery that I slide right off.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，正好踢到我。
lines.en: You stepped into the water and kicked me.

lines.zh: 大鱼撞小鱼，我习惯了。
lines.en: Big fish bump small fish, I am used to it.

lines.zh: 别抓我尾巴，那里最敏感。
lines.en: Do not grab my tail, it is the most sensitive.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花四溅。
lines.en: We collide and water splashes everywhere.

lines.zh: 我绕着同伴转，鳞光一闪一闪。
lines.en: I circle my mate, scales flashing.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾巴同步摆动。
lines.en: We swim side by side, tails beating together.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰她的侧腹。
lines.en: I gently nudge her flank.

lines.zh: 产卵的季节，海水都变暖了。
lines.en: In spawning season, even the sea feels warmer.

lines.zh: 她游前面，我守在后面。
lines.en: She swims ahead and I guard the rear.

lines.zh: 我们找一片安静的海草床。
lines.en: We look for a quiet bed of seagrass.

lines.zh: 我用鳍扫过她的背脊。
lines.en: I brush her back with my fin.

lines.zh: 鱼群会记住我们这一对。
lines.en: The school will remember the two of us.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正在谈正事。
lines.en: Do not disturb us, we are busy here.

lines.zh: 她走了，我还在原地打转。
lines.en: She left, and I still circle the spot.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块亮石头，又吐出来。
lines.en: I pick up a bright stone and spit it out.

lines.zh: 这东西能吃吗，我咬一口。
lines.en: Can this be eaten? I take one bite.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶着小鱼，往家里游。
lines.en: I carry a small fish home in my mouth.

lines.zh: 铁片太硬，我牙都酸了。
lines.en: The iron scrap is hard, my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 我捡到一枚贝壳，很得意。
lines.en: I found a shell and I am very proud.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿沉，我拖不动。
lines.en: This thing is heavy, I cannot drag it.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏进石缝里。
lines.en: I hide my find inside a crevice.

lines.zh: 沉下水的东西，都归我。
lines.en: Whatever sinks is mine.

lines.zh: 我用鳍夹着，游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I hold it in my fin and swim crooked.

lines.zh: 这块鱼肉，我先咬住。
lines.en: I clamp this fish first.

lines.zh: 前面那群小鱼，我盯上了。
lines.en: That school of small fish, I have chosen it.

lines.zh: 我锁定一条落单的鱼。
lines.en: I lock onto one fish that strayed.

lines.zh: 你的鱼竿在动，我改变主意。
lines.en: Your rod is moving, so I change my mind.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备冲刺。
lines.en: I lower my body and prepare to dash.

lines.zh: 目标不大，刚好一口。
lines.en: The target is small, just one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我闻到受伤鱼的挣扎。
lines.en: I smell a wounded fish struggling.

lines.zh: 那只螃蟹横着走，我跟着。
lines.en: That crab walks sideways, I follow it.

lines.zh: 我选最慢的那条追。
lines.en: I chase the slowest one in the group.

lines.zh: 我的大腹肉，游得最慢。
lines.en: My fatty belly makes me the slowest swimmer.

lines.zh: 别怪我，海里就是这样。
lines.en: Do not blame me, that is how the sea works.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，找破绽。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for an opening.

lines.zh: 水流正把我推向你。
lines.en: The current is pushing me toward you.

lines.zh: 别看我，我在盯那条小鱼。
lines.en: Don't look at me; I'm watching that little fish.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: I hug the seabed and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 别转身，我就在你后面。
lines.en: Do not turn around, I am right behind.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己露出空档。
lines.en: I wait for you to leave a gap.

lines.zh: 尾鳍绷紧，随时能冲。
lines.en: My tail fin is tense, ready to dash.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼比你有吸引力。
lines.en: The fish in your hand is more tempting than you.

lines.zh: 我假装游开，其实在绕后。
lines.en: I pretend to leave, but circle behind you.

lines.zh: 这一口，我盯很久了。
lines.en: I have watched this bite for a long time.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你腿上。
lines.en: I ram my head into your leg.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，往深处拖。
lines.en: I bite down and drag you deeper.

lines.zh: 我甩尾扫过去，水花四溅。
lines.en: I whip my tail across, scattering water.

lines.zh: 我撞翻你的水桶，鱼全跑了。
lines.en: I knock over your bucket and the fish escape.

lines.zh: 你抓我，我就咬你手指。
lines.en: Grab me and I will bite your fingers.

lines.zh: 这一撞，够你退两步。
lines.en: This charge will push you back two steps.

lines.zh: 我在水下撞你膝盖。
lines.en: I strike your knee from under the water.

lines.zh: 血腥味散开，我咬得更狠。
lines.en: The smell of blood spreads, and I bite harder.

lines.zh: 别小看一条鱼的力气。
lines.en: Do not underestimate the strength of a fish.

lines.zh: 咬完我就游走了。
lines.en: After biting, I swim away.

lines.zh: 我从深水里浮上来，第一次见光。
lines.en: I rise from the deep and see light for the first time.

lines.zh: 这片海是新家，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: This sea is my new home, I circle it first.

lines.zh: 我刚出生就会游，别小看鱼。
lines.en: I could swim at birth, do not underestimate fish.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到礁石边。
lines.en: The tide pushed me against the reef.

lines.zh: 鱼群在等我归队。
lines.en: The school is waiting for me to join.

lines.zh: 我摆摆尾，确认自己还活着。
lines.en: I flick my tail to confirm I am alive.

lines.zh: 冷流里，我睁开第一只眼。
lines.en: In the cold current, I open my first eye.

lines.zh: 这里的水味很陌生。
lines.en: The taste of this water is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我从卵里挣出来，浑身发软。
lines.en: I struggled out of the egg, my body weak.

lines.zh: 新的海域，新的猎场。
lines.en: A new sea, and a new hunting ground.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我跳起来。
lines.en: The water is boiling, I leap out.

lines.zh: 掉在地上，一身好肉都青了。
lines.en: On the ground, all my good meat bruised.

lines.zh: 我在水里怎么会淹到。
lines.en: How does a fish drown in water?

lines.zh: 炸起的水柱把我抛了上去。
lines.en: The blast throws me up with the water.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿过水面，带走几片鳞。
lines.en: The arrow cuts the water and takes scales with it.

lines.zh: 咒文一碰，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: A spell touches me and my body goes numb.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到鱼了。
lines.en: I have not eaten a fish in three days.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and I flinch.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我快干了。
lines.en: There is no water here and I am drying out.
